title.en: AN ACT REDUCING THE NUMBER OF MUNICIPALITIES IN THE PROVINCE OF ALBAY FROM TWENTY-SEVEN TO TWENTY-THREE, BY CONSOLIDATING CERTAIN MUNICIPALITIES OF THE SAID PROVINCE LOCATED IN THE SUBPROVINEE OF CATANDUANES.

The twenty-seven municipalities of the' Province of Albay shall, in accordance with the provisions
of this Act, be reduced to twenty-three, by consolidating certain municipalities of the said province located in
